I am Dhruv Grover, a third-year undergraduate student at the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Roorkee, India. I was born and brought up in India. I love listening to music and have recently learned guitar. I am always available to play a badminton match. I joined CCWJ on 10th May 2022 as a Mitacs GRI intern. I will be working on segmentation of droplets in GMAW welding process. This project applies machine learning techniques to the automated high-speed video images of molten metal in welding.

## Project

Artificial Intelligence and TensorFlow for High Speed Video Analysis.
